mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_config ( organization_id, agent_type, name, enabled, model_profile, prompt_version, schema_version, config, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{organizationId}, 'SALES_FOLLOW_UP', '客户跟进建议 Agent', true, 'default', 'sales-follow-up-v1', 'sales-follow-up-v1', '{"recentDays":30,"maxCustomers":5}'::jsonb, #{now}, #{now} ) ON CONFLICT (organization_id, agent_type, name) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM agent_config WHERE organization_id = #{organizationId} AND agent_type = 'SALES_FOLLOW_UP' ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_run ( id, organization_id, agent_config_id, initiated_by_member_id, trigger_type, status, business_date, deduplication_key, scope, input_snapshot, queued_at, started_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{organizationId}, #{agentConfigId}, #{initiatedByMemberId}, #{triggerType}, #{status}, #{businessDate}, #{deduplicationKey}, #{scope,typeHandler=com.yourcompany.salesagent.shared.persistence.JsonbMapTypeHandler}, #{inputSnapshot,typeHandler=com.yourcompany.salesagent.shared.persistence.JsonbMapTypeHandler}, #{queuedAt}, #{startedAt}, #{startedAt}, #{startedAt} )

INSERT INTO agent_step ( id, organization_id, run_id, customer_id, sequence_no, step_type, name, status, input_snapshot, output_snapshot, error_message, started_at, completed_at, duration_ms, created_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{organizationId}, #{runId}, #{customerId}, #{sequenceNo}, #{stepType}, #{name}, #{status}, #{inputSnapshot,typeHandler=com.yourcompany.salesagent.shared.persistence.JsonbMapTypeHandler}, #{outputSnapshot,typeHandler=com.yourcompany.salesagent.shared.persistence.JsonbMapTypeHandler}, #{errorMessage}, #{startedAt}, #{completedAt}, #{durationMs}, #{startedAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_run SET status = #{status}, total_candidates = #{totalCandidates}, processed_count = #{processedCount}, succeeded_count = #{succeededCount}, skipped_count = #{skippedCount}, failed_count = #{failedCount}, pending_approval_count = #{pendingApprovalCount}, output_summary = #{outputSummary,typeHandler=com.yourcompany.salesagent.shared.persistence.JsonbMapTypeHandler}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, completed_at = CASE WHEN #{status} IN ('COMPLETED', 'PARTIALLY_COMPLETED', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED') THEN CAST(#{completedAt} AS timestamp with time zone) ELSE NULL::timestamp with time zone END, updated_at = CAST(#{completedAt} AS timestamp with time zone), version = version + 1 WHERE organization_id = #{organizationId} AND id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT run.id, config.name, run.trigger_type, CASE WHEN run.status = 'RUNNING' THEN run.status WHEN coalesce(review.pending_approval_count, 0) > 0 THEN 'WAITING_APPROVAL' WHEN run.status = 'WAITING_APPROVAL' AND run.failed_count > 0 AND run.succeeded_count > 0 THEN 'PARTIALLY_COMPLETED' WHEN run.status = 'WAITING_APPROVAL' AND run.failed_count > 0 THEN 'FAILED' WHEN run.status = 'WAITING_APPROVAL' THEN 'COMPLETED' ELSE run.status END AS status, run.business_date, run.scope, CASE WHEN run.status = 'WAITING_APPROVAL' AND coalesce(review.pending_approval_count, 0) = 0 THEN jsonb_set( coalesce(run.output_summary, '{}'::jsonb), '{message}', to_jsonb('审批已全部处理，跟进任务已更新'::text), true ) ELSE run.output_summary END AS output_summary, run.total_candidates, run.processed_count, run.succeeded_count, run.skipped_count, run.failed_count, coalesce(review.pending_approval_count, 0) AS pending_approval_count, run.error_message, run.queued_at, run.started_at, CASE WHEN run.completed_at IS NOT NULL THEN run.completed_at WHEN run.status = 'WAITING_APPROVAL' AND coalesce(review.pending_approval_count, 0) = 0 THEN run.updated_at ELSE run.completed_at END AS completed_at, run.created_at FROM agent_run run JOIN agent_config config ON config.organization_id = run.organization_id AND config.id = run.agent_config_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT count(*) FILTER ( WHERE a.status = 'PENDING' AND ar.status = 'AWAITING_APPROVAL' )::integer AS pending_approval_count FROM action_request ar LEFT JOIN approval a ON a.organization_id = ar.organization_id AND a.action_request_id = ar.id WHERE ar.organization_id = run.organization_id AND ar.run_id = run.id ) review ON true WHERE run.organization_id = #{organizationId} ORDER BY run.created_at DESC, run.id DESC

SELECT run.id, config.name, run.trigger_type, CASE WHEN run.status = 'RUNNING' THEN run.status WHEN coalesce(review.pending_approval_count, 0) > 0 THEN 'WAITING_APPROVAL' WHEN run.status = 'WAITING_APPROVAL' AND run.failed_count > 0 AND run.succeeded_count > 0 THEN 'PARTIALLY_COMPLETED' WHEN run.status = 'WAITING_APPROVAL' AND run.failed_count > 0 THEN 'FAILED' WHEN run.status = 'WAITING_APPROVAL' THEN 'COMPLETED' ELSE run.status END AS status, run.business_date, run.scope, CASE WHEN run.status = 'WAITING_APPROVAL' AND coalesce(review.pending_approval_count, 0) = 0 THEN jsonb_set( coalesce(run.output_summary, '{}'::jsonb), '{message}', to_jsonb('审批已全部处理，跟进任务已更新'::text), true ) ELSE run.output_summary END AS output_summary, run.total_candidates, run.processed_count, run.succeeded_count, run.skipped_count, run.failed_count, coalesce(review.pending_approval_count, 0) AS pending_approval_count, run.error_message, run.queued_at, run.started_at, CASE WHEN run.completed_at IS NOT NULL THEN run.completed_at WHEN run.status = 'WAITING_APPROVAL' AND coalesce(review.pending_approval_count, 0) = 0 THEN run.updated_at ELSE run.completed_at END AS completed_at, run.created_at FROM agent_run run JOIN agent_config config ON config.organization_id = run.organization_id AND config.id = run.agent_config_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT count(*) FILTER ( WHERE a.status = 'PENDING' AND ar.status = 'AWAITING_APPROVAL' )::integer AS pending_approval_count FROM action_request ar LEFT JOIN approval a ON a.organization_id = ar.organization_id AND a.action_request_id = ar.id WHERE ar.organization_id = run.organization_id AND ar.run_id = run.id ) review ON true WHERE run.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND run.id = #{runId} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, customer_id, sequence_no, step_type, name, status, input_snapshot, output_snapshot, error_message, started_at, completed_at, duration_ms FROM agent_step WHERE organization_id = #{organizationId} AND run_id = #{runId} ORDER BY sequence_no
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO action_request ( id, organization_id, run_id, step_id, customer_id, requested_by_member_id, action_type, risk_level, status, tool_name, tool_version, reason, payload, payload_hash, preview, requires_approval, policy_decision, policy_snapshot, idempotency_key, expires_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{organizationId}, #{runId}, #{stepId}, #{customerId}, #{requestedByMemberId}, #{actionType}, #{riskLevel}, #{status}, 'internal.follow_up.create', 'v1', #{reason}, #{payload,typeHandler=com.yourcompany.salesagent.shared.persistence.JsonbMapTypeHandler}, #{payloadHash}, #{preview,typeHandler=com.yourcompany.salesagent.shared.persistence.JsonbMapTypeHandler}, true, 'REQUIRE_APPROVAL', '{"policy":"manual-review-for-ai-follow-up"}'::jsonb, #{idempotencyKey}, #{expiresAt} )

INSERT INTO approval ( id, organization_id, action_request_id, requested_by_member_id, status, request_reason, content_hash, requested_at, expires_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{organizationId}, #{actionRequestId}, #{requestedByMemberId}, 'PENDING', #{requestReason}, #{contentHash}, #{requestedAt}, #{expiresAt} )
